usage: tr analyze [-h] [--session SESSION] [--prompt PROMPT] [--model MODEL]
                  [--arm {main,teacher}] [--teacher MODEL] [--max-usd MAX_USD]
                  ticker

positional arguments:
  ticker

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --session SESSION
  --prompt PROMPT       prompt version: prompts/<version>.txt (default
                        analyze-1; the teacher arm: analyze-3 with the
                        headlines withheld)
  --model MODEL
  --arm {main,teacher}
  --teacher MODEL       the teacher arm's model, pinned to its DeepInfra
                        endpoint: deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro,
                        qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507,
                        qwen/qwen3-next-80b-a3b-instruct
  --max-usd MAX_USD
